storage.location: refrigerator, same compartment as the device

meta.priorStorage: Unknown. Operator estimates the rice was cooked at least a week before the test.
meta.notes: cookedAtMs omitted because the cooking time is unknown. startedAtMs is the start of run R00062 (warm-up began then); the clean-air baseline used for scoring is 23:49 to 00:04 WAT. Readings were logged in calibration mode and labelled after the test; see runs/R00062/labelling.

mq1.note: MQ135 is not selective; curveGas names the datasheet curve used for ppm, not a measured gas

mq2.note: MQ135 is not selective; curveGas names the datasheet curve used for ppm, not a measured gas

stabilisation.rules: per channel: fault if mean V < noSignalV (no_signal), any reading at 4095 (saturation) or mean V > nearAdcLimitV (near_adc_limit); else settling while uptime < settleS; else valid. high_noise flag if within-minute V SD > noiseVSd (state unchanged). quality.state = worst channel. timeSource rebuilt = epoch reconstructed from uptime after the first clock sync.

labelling.notes: The board logged this run in calibration mode (no experimentId or sampleId set over Serial). The food_test label, experimentId and sampleId were added after the test from the operator log. The telemetry envelopes under samplesPath are unchanged and still carry experimentId CAL-R00062 and sampleId NONE.

baseline.notes: Clean air in the refrigerator before the rice went in; starts 2 minutes after the 1 h settling period ended (23:47).

food.notes: Rice in place and response settled; ends when MQ2 reached the ADC limit.

R00062-food-in.notes: Spoilt rice (about 0.25 kg, open, uncovered) placed in the refrigerator with the device. Before this the rice was kept sealed outside the refrigerator.

R00062-door-0009.notes: Refrigerator door opened at 00:09 WAT and closed at 00:10 WAT.

R00062-mq1-step-0034.notes: MQ1 voltage stepped down from about 2.55 V to 1.85 V at 00:34 to 00:35 WAT and recovered over about 8 minutes; MQ2 barely changed. Operator confirms nothing was done to the device or refrigerator. Cause unknown.

R00062-mq2-adc-limit.notes: MQ2 output reached the 3.3 V ADC limit on almost every sample from 01:58 WAT (quality fault, saturation). MQ2 readings from then on are a lower bound on gas level, not a measurement.

R00062-food-out.notes: Rice removed at about 02:09 WAT (time approximate). The operator handled the device while removing it. The refrigerator still smelled strongly, so recovery toward baseline was not measured.

R00064-restart.notes: Board restarted with reset reason BROWNOUT at about 02:09 WAT while the operator was removing the rice and handling the device. After the food period; not used in analysis.

R00063-restart.notes: Board restarted with reset reason TASK_WDT at about 02:10 WAT. After the food period; not used in analysis.

RICE-S01-obs-0011.label: spoiled
RICE-S01-obs-0011.notes: Smell and visual check by the operator: terrible smell; some grains turned yellow. No slime or mould seen (sample was refrigerated). Operator estimates the rice was at least a week old.
